name: Porth Tocyn Hotel
accommodation: 17 individually designed bedrooms, some interconnecting; self-catering cottage Bwthyn Bach and shepherd's hut Ty Cwtch
suitableFor: Couples and families wanting a hotel with a restaurant
confirmedFeatures: Restaurant, sea-view rooms, interconnecting family rooms, self-catering cottage and shepherd's hut in grounds
overview: Porth Tocyn Hotel stands on the headland at Bwlchtocyn beyond Abersoch, with views across Cardigan Bay to Snowdonia. It has 17 individually designed bedrooms, many with sea views, plus a cottage and shepherd's hut for self-catering. The restaurant serves evening and daytime meals.
surfTripFit: It suits a more comfortable surf trip, with Hell's Mouth a short drive across the peninsula and food on site after a session.
